summary: IDEAYA Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering through Jefferies LLC. The filing updates the remaining $156.6 million available under a $350 million sales agreement entered in January 2024, with $193.4 million already sold. Shares are sold on the Nasdaq at prevailing market prices; Jefferies receives up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special-situations event. There is no takeover, buyback, restructuring, or activist trigger. Investors should monitor dilution and market liquidity from ongoing ATM sales.
